newsitem.title: GREECE: BEFORE THE BELL: ETANE MAKES TRADE DEBUT JULY 8.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL: ETANE MAKES TRADE DEBUT JULY 8.

text.p: Greek construction firm Etane SA makes its trading debut on the bourse's small-cap parallel market on Tuesday July 8.

Etane went public at 1,850 drachmas a share in early June, its IPO oversubscribed 10 times. It tapped the market for 740 million drachmas with an offering of 400,000 common registered shares with a par value of 100 drachmas.
Issue advisor and lead underwriter was Telesis Securities.
Etane specialises in prefabricated construction, renovation and rehabilitation of landmark buildings and is a member of Europe's 500 -- an association of the fastest growing European companies.
The company will use IPO proceeds to finance equipment acquisitions, boost working capital and retire debt.
In fiscal 1996 its turnover rose 28 percent to 2.3 billion drachmas while pretax earnings grew 57 percent to 474 million.

Projections for this year see turnover advancing to 3.1 billion drachmas with pretax earnings growing to 630 million. On an after-tax basis, Etane is coming to market at a price earnings (P/E) ratio of 8.7 -- 8.3 times forecast 1997 net earnings.
Its orderbook of uncompleted projects currently stands at 6.0 billion drachmas, it said. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
